title: Platform hiring + onboarding sprint retro (Jul 8 2025)
content:
Attendees: Aisha, Ben, Meng, Ravi, Evelyn (sync 45m)

Purpose: weekly combined hiring + onboarding check-in focused on platform team health after recent batch of hires and interviews. Mix of rapid interview debriefs + early onboarding retro (30/60 day signals).

AGENDA:
- Quick hiring pipeline state (open reqs, timeline)
- Interview debriefs (3 candidates)
- 30-day new hire signals (Mia, Jonah, Priya)
- Operational blockers (provisioning, manager bandwidth)
- Action items + owners

HIRING PIPELINE (snapshot 2025-07-08):
- Open roles: 3 IC platform eng (req 102, 103, 104), 1 infra SRE (req 107)
- Recruiter funnel healthy, pipeline estimates: onsite schedule capacity next 2 weeks = 6 slots
- Priority: fill one mid-level IC (req 103) for product integration work

INTERVIEW DEBRIEFS (fast notes):
1) Candidate P7-2025 (backend/platform generalist) — interview date 2025-07-06
   - Interviewers: Ben, Meng, Evelyn
   - Technical fit: 7/10 — solid systems design, lacked experience with GPU infra orchestration
   - Culture/team fit: 8/10 — collaborative, good communication
   - Recommendation: small-pass -> invite for a focused systems design take-home OR schedule second loop focusing on infra ops experience
   - Risks: ramp time longer for model-serving specifics
   - Linked notes: (Ben) GHPR-234 linked to convo

2) Candidate P8-2025 (site reliability candidate) — interview date 2025-07-07
   - Interviewers: Ravi, Ben
   - Technical fit: 8/10 — strong on SRE tooling, alerting, runbooks
   - Practical test: automated chaos experiment idea was exactly what we need for failover testing
   - Recommendation: move to final onsite; can cover SLA ownership for Dedicated product
   - Hiring committee flags: need confirmation on on-call compensation

3) Candidate P9-2025 (senior infra eng) — interview date 2025-07-05
   - Interviewers: Meng, Evelyn
   - Technical fit: 6/10 — ambiguous depth on compilation/kernel selection topics we care about
   - Culture fit: 6/10 — less proactive in cross-team comms
   - Recommendation: decline; encourage to reapply if they pick up quant/kernels work

Notes: please add scorecards to ENG-HIRE-29 before 2025-07-10. Recruiter follow-ups: Ben -> schedule P7 take-home by Jul 11; Ravi -> confirm comp band for P8.

30/60 DAY ONBOARDING SIGNALS (new hires):
- Mia J. (joined 2025-06-09) — role: infra tools
  - Wins: delivered first internal demo for automated config-rollbacks; quickly merged two infra-as-code PRs
  - Blockers: unfinished access to internal GPU perf dashboards (request sent to infra-admins 2025-06-23, pending)
  - Mentorship: paired with Meng 2x/wk; request more structured 1:1 agenda
  - Health: positive, enthusiastic

- Jonah K. (joined 2025-05-15) — role: runtime performance
  - Wins: benchmarked 3 quantized model paths, produced exploratory notes
  - Blockers: limited quota on dedicated cluster for end-to-end tests (quota request PLAT-482 pending)
  - Mentorship: needs deeper product context; schedule product walkthrough with Aisha
  - Health: slightly overloaded; possible burnout risk if unblocked not resolved in 10 days

- Priya S. (joined 2025-06-23) — role: platform infra
  - Wins: set up local dev container workflow and onboarding doc draft
  - Blockers: laptop had intermittent Ethernet adapter issue; fixed but lost first-week momentum
  - Mentorship: good 1:1 cadence with Ravi
  - Health: neutral; settling in

TEAM HEALTH OBSERVATIONS:
- Manager bandwidth is currently the biggest constraint. Several new hires need short product/context ramp sessions; only one PM time slot available weekly.
- Provisioning gaps (dashboards, cluster quotas, laptop peripherals) are recurring and cost us early velocity.
- Peer-pairing is working well where scheduled; informal pairing less reliable.
- Hiring interview fatigue noted: interviewers have overloaded schedules (back-to-back loops). Could harm candidate experience.

OPERATIONS / BLOCKERS:
- PLAT-482 (cluster quota increase) stuck in finance approval — Aisha to escalate with Finance on Jul 9
- Access request for GPU perf dashboards — infra-admins ticket #INFR-119 open since Jun 23 (Meng to ping)
- On-call comp/expectations for SRE candidates — product + people ops need to finalize docs (Ravi to draft)

ACTION ITEMS (owner — due):
- Ben: collect and upload all interview scorecards for P7/P8/P9 to ENG-HIRE-29 (due 2025-07-10)
- Meng: ping infra-admins on INFR-119 and confirm dashboard access window (due 2025-07-09)
- Aisha: escalate PLAT-482 with Finance, loop in VP Eng if no update by Jul 10 (due 2025-07-10)
- Ravi: draft on-call comp guideline doc and share with people-ops (due 2025-07-14)
- Evelyn: schedule product-context 1:1 for Jonah (30m) and draft suggested agenda (due 2025-07-11)
- Talent/Recruiting (assigned): avoid scheduling >2 interview loops per day for same interviewer, stagger by at least half-day (effective immediately)

OPEN QUESTIONS / DECISIONS NEEDED:
- Do we formalize a 30/60-day onboarding checklist per role? (proposal: yes; owner: Aisha)
- What SLAs for provisioning can we commit to for new hires (laptop/access/cluster quota)? Need platform + IT + Finance alignment

QUICK SQUASH NOTES (informal):
- Happy hour for platform onboarding grads next Fri? small win to build cohesion.
- Consider a rotating "onboard buddy" assignment rather than ad-hoc pairing.

NEXT STEPS:
- Sync again next Tuesday 2025-07-15; focus will be hire decisions for P7/P8 and onboarding checklist draft review.
